title: EXPLORE CONSUMABLE AFFILIATE MARKETING WITH CHATGPT
content:
Affiliate marketing can be used for consumable products, but a replenishable product does not automatically create repeat affiliate commissions.

The merchant owns the product and transaction. You refer customers under the affiliate program's rules. Your job in this guide is to decide what kind of consumable and customer relationship you want to explore, then identify the program terms that would determine the economics.

THE REORDER QUESTION IS CENTRAL
If a customer buys through your referral and returns a month later for more, do you receive another commission? Maybe. Maybe not. Cookie duration, account attribution, subscription rules, last-click attribution, program-specific tracking, and other terms can affect the answer.

Do not infer recurring commission from recurring consumption.

PRODUCT FIT STILL COMES FIRST
A strong affiliate direction is not "I want a product with high commission." It is closer to "I want to help this audience choose products in this category, and affiliate relationships may be a way to earn from recommendations I would be comfortable making."

COPY & PASTE INTO CHATGPT

Interview me about a consumable affiliate-marketing direction. Ask about the audience I want to help, product categories I understand or am willing to research, whether I personally use or can responsibly evaluate products, desired customer relationship, content or recommendation role, and how important repeat commission is to me.

Help me create criteria for evaluating affiliate programs. Include commission structure, whether repeat orders can remain attributed, attribution duration, customer-account attribution, refunds, payout thresholds, prohibited promotion methods, disclosure requirements, program stability, and the merchant's customer experience.

Do not invent current program terms, commission rates, cookie durations, or product claims. Flag every program-specific fact for verification from current official terms.

At the end give me:
- Intended audience
- Consumable category
- Why recommendations could be useful to that audience
- Affiliate relationship I would need
- Whether recurring commission is important to the model
- Exact program terms to verify
- Concise business-direction statement

WHERE TO GO NEXT
If the direction is clear, continue to PDF 46. If repeat attribution is essential and affiliate programs do not provide the relationship you want, return to PDF 26 and compare another route.
